dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, thick white boundaries along the outer webs of folded primary and secondary feathers against dark gray-black feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition boundary where the pale, finely textured nape meets the high-contrast scaly pattern of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive, high-contrast 'scalloped' or 'fish-scale' pattern across the entire dorsal region including mantle, scapulars, and rump.
